entities.summary: Matthew William Bradley is a Canadian professional ice hockey scout and former player who is a scout for the Washington Capitals of the National Hockey League (NHL). He played in the NHL for the San Jose Sharks, Pittsburgh Penguins, Washington Capitals and the Florida Panthers. He began working with the Washington Capitals as part of their scouting staff in 2015.
